## Summary

Describe the skill or catalog improvement and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py`.
- [ ] The skill name matches its directory and uses lowercase kebab-case.
- [ ] The description contains explicit **Use when** triggers and overlap boundaries where needed.
- [ ] Required inputs, output contract, safety boundaries, failure handling, and verification are concrete.
- [ ] I ran all new or changed scripts and executable examples.
- [ ] I tested one normal prompt and one edge or failure prompt.
- [ ] I updated the README index and exact skill count.
- [ ] Changing or high-impact claims cite dated authoritative sources.

## Test Evidence

List the commands and prompts you ran, then summarize the observed results.

## Safety and Scope

State any permissions, destructive actions, external writes, sensitive data, or professional-review requirements introduced by this change.
